Commentary.Commentary: USA will be pleased with how they bowled, especially the likes of Saurabh Netravalkar and Kyle Phillip! The two were excellent. However, USA will be very disappointed with their fielding. They dropped catches at crucial times and that could well cost them. They though will be happy they ended well. Now onto their batting which will fancy their chances on a wicket which is good for batting. Windies on the other hand, will back themselves to restrict this. Join us for the chase in a bit.

Windies have done really, really well to get to where they have after the start they were off too.They lost two for not a lot, Johnson Charles and Shai Hope then counter-attacked. The two took the attack to the bowlers and took their side to safer shores. Both scored half tons but both fell in quick succession. Chase then continued the good work. He had two good stands, one with Pooran and the other with Holder who also scored a half ton. However, the problem with Windies was no batter went onto make it big and hence, they fell short of the 300-run mark.
OUT! TAKEN! Windies have been bowled out for under 300! This is fuller and outside off, this is slammed hard but straight to Steven Taylor at covers. WINDIES HAVE BEEN BOWLED OUT FOR 297!

It is time for the qualifiers, 10 teams will battle to make a place for themselves in the upcoming World Cup. Just the two will get to do so, so who will the two be?
